name: Pyme
source: She is a demon girl with a relatively human-like appearance. Because of the similarities to the appearance of the humans, Pyme is looked down by both demons and humans, making her a half-baked being. Ever since she was young, she has been sympathetic towards Ladiesthor and has been bothering him since. Pyme has a feeling for Ladiesthor but could not be honest with him. Her strength is much greater than that of humans, and she fights wielding a huge hammer.
